visual_review.assessment: Six complete crowned masked bandit poses preserve two curved daggers, amber hood and tattered ochre cloak. Articulated boot/knee and cloak changes exist, but the same leading leg dominates. One bounded gait correction still lacks an unmistakable opposite-leg half-cycle; original kept for identity continuity.
